name: LeadPulse Clay Editorial Action Sheet
scope: A mobile-first, intent-led illustrated action sheet for LeadPulse. Design reference only: no app code, data, mascot, or production changes are authorized.

design_intent.not: A celebratory landing page, dense infographic, or a mascot-heavy CRM reskin
design_intent.goal: Let Pat choose a sales task through three calm, understandable actions while retaining the familiar LeadPulse claymation identity.
design_intent.core_rule: Clay is the illustration layer, not the interface chrome. The UI stays quiet, paper-like, and operational.

why_the_current_direction_can_feel_jarri.working_assumption: The clay style feels too present when large mascots, saturated lane colors, card motion, and operational data compete on the same screen.
correction: Reserve a mascot for one focused entry sheet, milestone, or empty state.
Use one fixed mascot per choice, not a cast scattered across every card.
Put clay art on a neutral or softly tinted shelf, never inside a loud multicolor panel.
Use short, practical copy and one task per card.

screen.name: Choose your next sales action
recommended_entry_points: An explicit ‘Start a task’ control on Today
A first-run prompt after a deliberate user tap
An empty-state recovery action when there is no active work
do_not_auto_open: During editing, saving, or a destructive confirmation
structure: Single white or warm-paper bottom sheet
Close control and natural swipe/back dismissal

content_model.headline: What do you want to do?
content_model.supporting_copy: Choose one task and LeadPulse will take you straight there.

actions.title: Follow up with someone
actions.description: See who needs a touch today.
actions.destination: Today action queue or filtered Deals board

actions.title: Add a new lead
actions.description: Capture a company or contact before you forget.
actions.destination: Existing New Contact or New Company flow

actions.title: Log a touch
actions.description: Save a call, email, DM, or meeting.

copy_rules.title: Verb-first, 2 to 6 words
copy_rules.description: One plain-language sentence, 42 characters preferred and 70 characters maximum
copy_rules.action_count: Exactly three on mobile. Add a separate ‘More actions’ route rather than a fourth crowded card.
avoid: Generic labels such as ‘Get started’ or ‘Continue’
Sales jargon such as ‘advance deal’ or ‘engage account’
Multiple metrics, instructions, or a second CTA inside one choice

layout.sheet_position: Bottom sheet on mobile; centered dialog with a visible underlying page on desktop

action_card.background: var(--color-clay-surface) or white, never a saturated full-card fill
action_card.illustration_alignment: Right-aligned, slightly cropped at the card edge, with one small softly tinted abstract shape behind it
action_card.interaction: Entire card is one button. No nested buttons, pills, or surprise secondary action.

layout.responsive_rule: Cards remain stacked on phones. Do not turn the three choices into a carousel or a three-column desktop grid.

visual_language.ui_surface: Warm paper and quiet white surfaces, crisp enough to feel editorial but still compatible with LeadPulse's clay desk.
visual_language.illustration: Existing LeadPulse claymation PNGs become composed still-life objects. They should feel curated and static, not like a mascot reacting to every CRM event.

color_discipline.rule: Each card gets one pale accent at 10% to 18% opacity. Coral and pink can appear only as minor art details. Tomato red remains danger-only.

mascot_treatment.source: Reuse fixed PNG assets under /public/assets/mascots via MascotSprite.
rules: No new AI-generated mascot, clay avatar, clay lettering, or human illustration.
No mascot frame, label, or job description inside the card.
The text must remain meaningful if the illustration fails to load.
Keep one consistent image scale and visual crop across all three cards.

motion.tone: Calm and physical, not bouncy or game-like.
motion.sheet: Backdrop opacity transition 160ms; sheet translateY(16px) plus opacity transition 220ms ease-out.
motion.cards: No autonomous bounce. On press, scale to 0.985 for 110ms and slightly deepen the border.
motion.mascots: Static by default. A single 160ms fade/scale-in is permitted when the sheet opens.
motion.reduced_motion: Instant state changes with no transforms or staggered entrances.

accessibility.dialog: Use a correctly labelled modal dialog with focus trapped inside, Escape dismissal, close button, and focus restored to the trigger.
accessibility.targets: Each action card is at least 48px tall and has a visible keyboard focus treatment.
accessibility.contrast: Card title/body text must meet WCAG AA against the actual paper surface. Accent colors must not be the only way choices differ.
screen_reader_names: Follow up with someone. See who needs a touch today.
Add a new lead. Capture a company or contact before you forget.
Log a touch. Save a call, email, DM, or meeting.

preserve: Action-first Deal board and its lane logic
Existing explicit Save, spinner, toast, success ring, and undo patterns
Warm light mode and midnight-cocoa dark-mode contrast rules
avoid: Adding mascot art to every list row or deal lane
Replacing operational DM Sans with editorial serif typography
Making the selector a second dashboard
Copying the reference screen's figures or exact illustrations
Auto-saving or changing CRM state just because a user chooses an entry action

acceptance_criteria: A user can understand all three choices without reading a tooltip.
Each choice opens an existing, explicit LeadPulse workflow and makes no write until the user confirms Save.
The sheet feels calmer than the current mascot-heavy treatment because the UI remains mostly neutral and each card uses one contained image.
On mobile, all three cards and their full labels are reachable without horizontal scrolling.
Dark mode uses existing night-desk tokens rather than a bright white pasted surface.
No Deal board action, lane rule, or mascot asset is changed by this pattern alone.
